punchline: A handful of relationships provide most of what we get from all of our relationships.
thirty_sec: Richard Koch applies the 80/20 principle to relationships: a small number of people provide most of the support, meaning and happiness in our lives. Yet our time often follows habit and obligation instead. His advice is to list the relationships that matter most, compare it with where your time actually goes, and invest more deliberately in the few. That isn't coldness; it's giving loved ones your best.
question: Who gets your best time right now, and who actually deserves it?
